subject.title: Next Sprint B: model-input validation guardrails

question: Should configured `models.providers.*.models[*].input` accept audio/video as model metadata, reject them as unsupported chat inputs, or require explicit provider-owned capability proof before runtime routing trusts them?
rationale: Current main accepts audio/video in the public config schema/type and preservation tests, while the session registry and docs still behave as if model input is text/image-only, so an automated fix would be choosing product/API direction.

options.title: Keep metadata, add semantic guards
options.body: Accept audio/video in catalog metadata, but prevent runtime routing from trusting unsupported user-declared capabilities unless provider-owned catalog proof or an explicit override contract exists.

options.title: Reject to text/image contract
options.body: Tighten configured model input to text/image only and add tests, docs, and a doctor migration or warning for any shipped configs that already contain audio/video.

options.title: Land catalog acceptance first
options.body: Allow the generated-catalog PR to proceed separately while leaving user-declared capability validation in this issue until maintainers settle the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Keep metadata, add semantic guards
recommendation.body: Accept audio/video in catalog metadata, but prevent runtime routing from trusting unsupported user-declared capabilities unless provider-owned catalog proof or an explicit override contract exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is tied to the current release snapshot for both the wide config schema/type and the narrower registry surface that need reconciliation.
